Hi Alex,

Thanks again for running the week-long POC with us. I wanted to share a concise recap of the operational wins we observed and ask for a quick favor if BrightMart is comfortable.

- Cost per 1k tokens reduced ~38% after enabling KV caching + optimized batching profiles.
- Peak throughput improved ~3x on the same GPU footprint (sustained 120 rps vs 38 rps).
- Reranking precision@10 improved by +6 percentage points with the tuned model variant on your evaluation set.

I've attached the pilot_metrics_spreadsheet.xlsx and a latency comparison screenshot for reference.
